title: Resolution urging Albany to base vaccine rules on medical experts
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Assembly to pass, and the Governor to sign, three bills (A.8824A/S.8334A, A.9648/S.8853 and A.9060C/S.8496C) that would require vaccine regulation, recommendations, administration and insurance coverage in New York to follow guidance from nationally and internationally recognized medical organizations, not solely the federal Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices. It cites falling childhood flu vaccination rates in New York City and recent disputes over federal vaccine policy as reasons for the state legislation. The three State Senate bills passed the Senate and were sent to the Assembly on March 4, 2026.
